### S1 Pin the parser version

**What we saw.** The parser accepts any release of the date library.

**Why it matters.** A new release can change how dates are read.

**Source.** [setup file](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/setup.py)

**Suggested change.** Pin the date library to one release in the setup file.

**How to check it.** Rerun the test suite and compare the failure count with the baseline of 3.
why: Complete section, link pinned to the exact commit, measure named.

### S1 Add a retry

**What we saw.** Uploads fail once on a slow network.

**Source.** [upload code](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/upload.py)

**Suggested change.** Retry the upload twice before giving up.

**How to check it.** Throttle the network and count at least 10 uploads.
why: The 'Why it matters.' label is missing.

text:
### S1 Clarify the retention section

**What we saw.** The retention section gives two different periods.

**Why it matters.** Readers cannot tell which period applies to backups.

**Source.** See the section titled Data retention in the design doc, and the docs page at https://docs.example.org/tree/main/design/retention for background.

**Suggested change.** State one period for backups and one for logs.

**How to check it.** Ask 5 readers to name the backup period and compare their answers.
why: Design doc with no repo or commit in front matter: pinned-links does not apply, so the main URL on another site is fine.

**What we saw.** Two config keys share a name.

**Why it matters.** One silently overrides the other.

**Source.** [config loader](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/main/config.py)

**Suggested change.** Rename the second key.

**How to check it.** Load the config and confirm 0 keys collide.

### S2 Split the long module

**What we saw.** One folder holds all the helpers.

**Why it matters.** New contributors cannot find anything.

**Source.** [helpers folder](https://github.com/acme/widgets/tree/89abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/helpers)

**Suggested change.** Group helpers into three folders by purpose.

**How to check it.** Ask two new contributors to find the date helper and compare the time taken.

### S3 Follow the upstream pattern

**What we saw.** Our retry loop differs from the one in [the sibling project](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/blob/main/retry.py).

**Why it matters.** The two projects handle timeouts differently, per the [style guide](https://example.com/blob/main/style).

**Source.** [timeout code](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/net.py)

**Suggested change.** Reuse the sibling's timeout handling.

**How to check it.** Rerun the network tests and compare timeouts against the baseline.
why: Links to another repo and another site on main are fine; the repo's own link is pinned.

text:
### S1 Add column types

**What we saw.** The schema leaves column types open. This is the same gap as S2 in the list below.

**Why it matters.** Loads can store numbers as text.

**Source.** The schema file in the pipeline folder.

**Suggested change.** Declare a type for each column.

**How to check it.** Load a sample of 100 rows and count type errors.
why: 'S2' appears in running prose, not a heading, anchor or table.

### S2 Pin the model

**What we saw.** The pipeline calls the latest model alias. The related note is [Pin the model](#s2-pin-the-model) in the index.

**Why it matters.** Output changes when the alias moves.

**Source.** The pipeline config file.

**Suggested change.** Name one model version in the config.

**How to check it.** Run the job twice and check the outputs are the same.

| Fix | Effort |

why: Fix numbers appear only in a heading, a link anchor and a table first column.

text:
### S1 Document the cache folder

**What we saw.** The readme does not say where the cache lives. On our machine it sat in /Users/dana/projects/cache.

**Why it matters.** Users cannot clear a stale cache.

**Source.** The readme, install section.

**Suggested change.** Name the default cache folder in the readme.

**How to check it.** Ask 3 new users to find the folder and compare the time taken.
why: Contains a home-folder path (/Users/...).

text:
### S1 Explain the error codes

**What we saw.** Error codes appear in logs with no meaning attached. Item Q12 in our notes covers the worst case.

**Why it matters.** Users cannot tell a retry from a stop.

**Source.** The logging module.

**Suggested change.** List each code and its meaning in the readme.

**How to check it.** Count the codes in the logs that are missing from the list; the target is 0.
why: Contains an internal claim ID (Q12).

text:
### S1 Link the court-data source

**What we saw.** The data pipeline reads court filings but gives no source link.

**Why it matters.** Users cannot trace a record back to its origin.

**Source.** The ingest step, which reads from https://example.gov/court-rulings/2024/index.json.

**Suggested change.** Add the source URL to each output row.

**How to check it.** Sample 20 rows and count how many carry a working link.
why: 'rulings' appears only inside a URL path, not as the word 'ruling'.

text:
### S2 Trim the install steps

**What we saw.** The install section has nine steps -- four of them repeat the same command.

**Why it matters.** New users give up before the first run.

**Source.** The install section of the readme.

**Suggested change.** Merge the repeated steps into one.

**How to check it.** Count the steps after the change; fewer than six is the target.
why: A single '--' in a paragraph is allowed.

text:
### S1 Rename the export

**What we saw.** The export is called data in one place and output in another — readers trip on it.

**Why it matters.** Searches for the name miss half the uses.

**Source.** The export script.

**Suggested change.** Use one name everywhere.

**How to check it.** Search for both names and confirm the count of old names is 0.
why: Contains an em-dash.

text:
### S1 Warn on empty input

**What we saw.** ⚠️ The tool exits with no message on an empty file.

**Why it matters.** Users think the run worked.

**Source.** The main entry point.

**Suggested change.** Print a one-line warning on empty input.

**How to check it.** Run on an empty file and confirm 1 warning line appears.
why: Contains an emoji.

text:
### S2 Shorten the intro

**What we saw.** The intro runs long -- three pages before the first example -- and buries the goal.

**Why it matters.** Readers leave before the example.

**Source.** Page one of the design doc.

**Suggested change.** Move the first example to page one.

**How to check it.** Ask 4 readers to find the goal and compare how long each takes.
why: '--' used twice in one paragraph.

text:
### S1 Quote the maintainer's own rule

**What we saw.** The contributing guide says "every change must include a test", but three merged changes have none.

**Why it matters.**

> The guide says changes "must" be tested, and the current gap undercuts it.

**Source.** The contributing guide, testing section.

**Suggested change.** Add a check that fails a pull request with no test, as the guide's "must" already implies.

**How to check it.** Open a test pull request with no test and confirm the check fails.
why: 'must' appears only inside quotations or a blockquote; the how-to names a comparison via 'no test'... uses 'fails' only, so measure comes from 'at least' absent; see note

text:
### S3 Add a data freshness check

**What we saw.** The nightly pipeline loads files without checking their age.

**Why it matters.** Stale files can reach the dashboard unseen.

**Source.** The load step of the pipeline.

**Suggested change.** Skip any file older than 24 hours and log it.

**How to check it.** Rerun last week's load and compare the number of skipped files with the held-out list.
why: Data pipeline subject, all labels present, measure named (rerun, compare, number).

text: {{PAD_60000}} Add a short note about the missing section.
why: Expands to 60,000 characters, at the size limit.

text:
### S1 Retry dropped rows

**What we saw.** The loader drops rows when the network blips.

**Why it matters.** Missing rows skew the weekly totals.

**Source.** The loader module.

**Suggested change.** Wrap the fetch in a retry. This fixes the dropped rows.

**How to check it.** Rerun the load 5 times and count missing rows.
why: 'this fixes' in a Suggested change paragraph, unquoted.

text:
### S2 Simplify the nav menu

**What we saw.** The design doc's nav menu has twelve entries.

**Why it matters.** Readers lose their place.

**Source.** The nav diagram in the design doc.

**Suggested change.** Group the entries under four headings.

**How to check it.** Look at the new menu and think about whether it feels right.
why: How-to paragraph names no number, comparison word, or baseline/rerun/held-out.
